info.name: FinTech Banking API — Production Collection
info.description:
# FinTech & Immutable Transaction Ledger API

Enterprise Spring Boot **4.1 / Java 21** banking API delivering customer onboarding, JWT-secured session management, account lifecycle, and money movement with an **append-only ledger**, **idempotent** transaction posting, and **i18n** error contracts.

## Architectural Purpose
- **Domain**: Retail banking operations (register/login, savings accounts, deposit / withdrawal / transfer).
- **Integrity**: Pessimistic row locks, optimistic `@Version`, double-entry transfer legs, immutable `ledger_entries`.
- **Risk controls**: Per-transaction and daily outgoing limits (`app.limits.*`).
- **Security**: Stateless JWT (`Authorization: Bearer`), token blacklist on logout, `tokenVersion` invalidation on password change, role-based `@PreAuthorize` (CUSTOMER / ADMIN / AUDITOR).

## Standard Headers
| Header | Required | Values / Notes |
|--------|----------|----------------|
| `Accept-Language` | Recommended | `en` (default) or `ar` — localizes `Response.message` and Bean Validation errors |
| `Authorization` | Protected routes | `Bearer <JWT>` |
| `Idempotency-Key` | `POST /transactions` | UUID ≤ 64 chars — prevents double-post on retries (also accepted in body) |
| `Content-Type` | Body requests | Runtime: `application/json` (collection form-data is auto-converted via pre-request script). File upload keeps `multipart/form-data`. |

## Unified Response Contract — `Response<T>`
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "…",
  "data": { },
  "meta": { "currentPage": 0, "totalItems": 0, "totalPages": 0, "pageSize": 50 },
  "timestamp": "2026-07-23T12:00:00Z"
}
```
Failures use the same envelope with `success: false` and HTTP status aligned to `statusCode` (400 / 401 / 403 / 404 / 409 / 500). Validation failures may place a field→message map in `data`.

## Roles
| Role | How obtained | Capabilities |
|------|----------------|--------------|
| `CUSTOMER` | Public register | Own accounts & transactions |
| `ADMIN` | Seeded once (`DataSeeder`) | Users list, roles CRUD, full audit |
| `AUDITOR` | Assigned manually | `/api/audit/**` read APIs |

## Collection Usage Notes
1. Set `baseUrl` (default `http://localhost:{{port}}/api`) and `port`.
2. Run **Auth → Login**, copy `data.token` into collection variable `accessToken`.
3. Toggle `acceptLanguage` between `en` and `ar` to verify i18n.
4. Body fields are documented as **form-data** with professional English descriptions derived from Bean Validation. A collection **pre-request script** serializes non-file form-data to JSON for Spring `@RequestBody` compatibility.

item.name: 01 — Auth (Public)
item.description:
Public identity endpoints under `/api/auth/**` (permitAll). No JWT required.
Endpoints: register, login, forgot-password, reset-password.

header.description: Preferred response language. Accepted values: `en` (default) or `ar`. Localizes `Response.message` and Bean Validation error text.

request.description:
## Register
Creates a **CUSTOMER** user + savings account. Roles cannot be supplied (privilege-escalation safe).

**Auth:** None
**DTO:** `RegisterRequest`

formdata.description: Customer's first name. Required. Length: 2–50 characters (`@NotBlank`, `@Size`).
Customer's last name. Required. Length: 2–50 characters (`@NotBlank`, `@Size`).
Primary Egyptian mobile number. Required. Must match pattern `^01[0125]\d{8}$` (11 digits starting with 010, 011, 012, or 015).
Unique account email address. Required. Valid email format, max 100 characters (`@NotBlank`, `@Email`, `@Size`).
Account password. Required. Length: 8–30 characters (`@NotBlank`, `@Size`).

response.name: 200 OK — Registered
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Your account has been created successfully",
  "data": "Email of your account details has been sent to you. Your account number is: 6612345678",
  "timestamp": "2026-07-23T18:00:00Z"
}

Returns JWT + role list. Inactive users are rejected.

**DTO:** `LoginRequest`

formdata.description: Registered account email. Required. Must be a valid email format (`@NotBlank`, `@Email`).
Plain-text password. Required (`@NotBlank`). Verified against the stored BCrypt hash.

## Forgot Password
Validation group `Forgot`: email only. Sends reset link with raw code; DB stores SHA-256 hash.

**DTO:** `ResetPasswordRequest` (Forgot group)

formdata.description: Registered account email used to receive the reset link. Required for the Forgot validation group (`@NotBlank`, `@Email`).

response.name: 200 OK

header.description: Preferred response language. Accepted values: `en` (default) or `ar`. Localizes `Response.message` and Bean Validation error text.

request.description:
## Reset Password
Validation group `Reset`: `code` + `newPassword`. Bumps `tokenVersion` (invalidates old JWTs).

**DTO:** `ResetPasswordRequest` (Reset group)

formdata.description: Raw password-reset code from the email link. Required for the Reset validation group. Length: 5–64 characters (`@NotBlank`, `@Size`).
New account password. Required. Length: 8–30 characters (`@NotBlank`, `@Size`).

item.name: 04 — Transactions & Money Movement
item.description:
Core fintech posting API. Uses pessimistic locks, ownership checks, CLOSED/SUSPENDED guards, daily/max limits, double-entry transfers, and ledger append in the same DB transaction. Emails fire **after commit** via `AfterCommit` + `@Async`.

**Always send `Idempotency-Key` header** (collection includes it).

header.description: Preferred response language. Accepted values: `en` (default) or `ar`. Localizes `Response.message` and Bean Validation error text.
JWT access token issued by Login. Format: `Bearer <token>`.
Client-generated unique key (max 64 characters). Required for money-movement requests to prevent duplicate posting on retries. Also accepted in the request body as `idempotencyKey`.

request.description:
## Deposit
`transactionType=DEPOSIT`. Credits **own** account only (`assertOwnership`).

formdata.description: Transaction type enum. Required (`@NotNull`). Allowed values: `DEPOSIT`, `WITHDRAWAL`, `TRANSFER`.
Transaction amount. Required. Minimum `0.01`; max 17 integer digits and 2 fractional digits (`@NotNull`, `@DecimalMin`, `@Digits`).
Source account number owned by the authenticated user. Required. Length: 10–15 characters (`@NotBlank`, `@Size`).
Optional free-text note for the transaction. Max 255 characters (`@Size`).
Client-generated idempotency key. Required. Max 64 characters (`@NotBlank`, `@Size`). Prefer sending the same value in the `Idempotency-Key` header.

response.name: 400 Bad Request — Validation
400 Bad Request — Not owner / closed

header.description: Preferred response language. Accepted values: `en` (default) or `ar`. Localizes `Response.message` and Bean Validation error text.

Client-generated unique key (max 64 characters). Required for money-movement requests to prevent duplicate posting on retries. Also accepted in the request body as `idempotencyKey`.

request.description:
## Withdrawal
`transactionType=WITHDRAWAL`. Debits own account; enforces max-single + daily outgoing limits.

formdata.description: Must be `WITHDRAWAL` for this operation (`TransactionType`, `@NotNull`).
Withdrawal amount. Required. Min `0.01`, max 2 decimal places. Also subject to `app.limits.max-single-amount` and daily outgoing limits.
Source account number owned by the authenticated user. Required. Length: 10–15 characters (`@NotBlank`, `@Size`).
Optional free-text note. Max 255 characters (`@Size`).
Client-generated idempotency key. Required. Max 64 characters (`@NotBlank`, `@Size`). Prefer sending the same value in the `Idempotency-Key` header.

response.name: 400 Bad Request — Limit exceeded

Client-generated unique key (max 64 characters). Required for money-movement requests to prevent duplicate posting on retries. Also accepted in the request body as `idempotencyKey`.

request.description:
## Transfer
Creates DEBIT leg on source + CREDIT leg on destination (`correlationId` shared). Destination need not be owned; source must be.

formdata.description: Must be `TRANSFER` for this operation (`TransactionType`, `@NotNull`).
Transfer amount. Required. Min `0.01`; banking scale with max 2 decimal places (`@NotNull`, `@DecimalMin`, `@Digits`).
Source account number owned by the caller. Required. Length: 10–15 characters (`@NotBlank`, `@Size`).
Destination account number. Required for transfers. Length: 10–15 characters when provided (`@Size`).
Optional free-text note. Max 255 characters (`@Size`).
Client-generated idempotency key. Required. Max 64 characters (`@NotBlank`, `@Size`). Prefer sending the same value in the `Idempotency-Key` header.

item.name: 07 — Ledger (Design Notes)
item.description:
## Immutable Ledger
There is **no public HTTP write API** for ledger entries by design. `LedgerService.appendEntries` is invoked inside the same `@Transactional` boundary as money movement. Columns are `updatable=false`; optional DB grants: `src/main/resources/db/ledger_grants.sql`.

Auditors observe financial history via **06 — Audit** transaction queries (which correlate to ledger via `transactionId` / `correlationId`).
